components.name: wand
components.excluded_reason: Wand's own installer and Compose stack, removed on 2026-11-08. The local stack never used them (it builds from local/compose.yml and local/web/), and Wand's Compose file publishes PostgreSQL on every network interface. templates/ and servers.xml are still used and remain.
